question: Will the Bank of Brazil decrease the target for the Selic rate by 25 bps at the August meeting?
rules:
This market will resolve according to the change in basis points in the target for the Selic rate resulting from the August 2026 meeting of the Bank of Brazil’s Monetary Policy Committee (COPOM), relative to the level it was prior to this meeting.

The resolution source will be official information from the Bank of Brazil, including the statement or release from its August 2026 Monetary Policy Committee meeting, scheduled for August 3-4, 2026, as listed on the official Bank of Brazil calendar (https://www.bcb.gov.br/en/about/bcb-calendar?categoria=Monetary%20Policy%20Committee%20(Copom)). This market may resolve as soon as the statement or release of the the Bank of Brazil's August 2026 Monetary Policy Committee meeting with relevant data is issued. 

If the specified rate is defined by an upper and lower bound, the relevant change will be the change to the upper bound. 

If the specified rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded according to the following guidelines. evidence.publisher: International Monetary Fund — statement by Brazil's Executive Director and advisers
evidence.excerpt: After signaling the beginning of rate cuts in February, the BCB cut rates by 25 bps in March, April, and June, bringing the policy rate to 14.25%. Heightened global uncertainty warrants a data-dependent approach to monetary policy. Inflation, which had been declining before the war, began to rise, as did inflation expectations.

evidence.publisher: Broadcast / Grupo Estado
evidence.excerpt: A mediana do relatório Focus para a taxa Selic no fim de 2026 seguiu em 14,00% pela quarta semana seguida. Considerando só as 40 estimativas atualizadas nos últimos cinco dias úteis, mais sensíveis a novidades, a mediana para a Selic no fim deste ano subiu de 13,75% para em 14,00%.

evidence.publisher: Reuters, syndicated by MarketScreener
evidence.excerpt: Brazil's government raised its inflation forecast for this year to 5.1% on Wednesday from 4.5% projected in May, putting consumer prices above the central bank's target of 3%, with a tolerance band of 1.5 percentage points in either direction. It added, however, that underlying inflation measures have shown a slowdown in recent months. The government kept its forecast for economic growth at 2.3% this year, saying activity remained resilient through May, but stressed that high real interest rates are poised to restrain the pace of growth ahead, with their full effects taking time to filter through the economy.

evidence.publisher: Banco Central do Brasil
evidence.excerpt: No cenário atual, caracterizado por forte aumento da incerteza, o Comitê reafirma serenidade e cautela na condução da política monetária, de forma que os passos futuros do processo de calibração da taxa básica de juros possam incorporar novas informações que aumentem a clareza sobre a profundidade e a extensão dos conflitos no Oriente Médio, assim como seus efeitos diretos e indiretos sobre o nível de preços ao longo do tempo.

evidence.publisher: Reuters, syndicated by Investing.com
evidence.excerpt: Brazil’s central bank cut rates at a third straight meeting on Wednesday and left its next steps open, acknowledging a tougher inflation outlook and risks from election-year fiscal stimulus. The bank’s rate-setting committee, called Copom, unanimously voted to lower its benchmark Selic rate by 25 basis points to 14.25%, a level last seen in May 2025, in line with forecasts from 41 of 45 economists polled by Reuters.

evidence.publisher: Banco Central do Brasil — press release republished by Publicnow
evidence.excerpt: O Banco Central publicou nesta terça-feira (24/6) o calendário das reuniões do Comitê de Política Monetária (Copom) em 2026. The published schedule lists the August meeting for 4 and 5 August 2026. As atas do Copom serão publicadas às 8 horas da terça-feira seguinte às reuniões do comitê.

question: Will Russia capture Toretske by July 31, 2026?
rules:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if, according to the ISW map, Russia captures the intersection at 48.494901° N, 37.365342° E in Toretske, Donetsk Oblast, by July 31, 2026, at 11:59 PM ET.

The intersection will be considered captured if any part of the intersection is shaded red on the ISW map (https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/36a7f6a6f5a9448496de641cf64bd375) by the resolution date. If the area is not shaded red by the specified date, the market will resolve to “No”.

For any change on the ISW map to qualify for this market’s resolution, the relevant shading indicating Russian control must persist through the next full ISW daily update cycle. If ISW skips a day, shading must persist until the next finalized ISW update is published, regardless of the date. Any continuous shading which reflects either “Assessed Russian Control”, “Assessed Russian Advance In Ukraine”, or “Assessed Russian Gains in the Past 24 Hours” will qualify. “Assessed Russian Infiltration Areas in Ukraine” will not qualify.

If Russia comes into control of this territory as a result of a negotiated settlement, this will qualify for a 'Yes' resolution, regardless of whether it is shaded red in the ISW map.

evidence.publisher: UNN, citing the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine
evidence.excerpt: During the past day, July 17, 276 combat engagements occurred on the front line. The largest number of assault actions was recorded in the Pokrovsk direction, where Ukrainian defenders stopped 43 attacks. The enemy's fire activity and assaults were recorded in the directions of Novopavlivka, Sofiivka, Toretske, Bilytske, Novyi Donbas, Bilozerske, Shevchenko, Hryshyne, Myrne, Vasylivka, Serhiivka, Udachne and Molodetske.

evidence.publisher: Ukrinform, citing the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine
evidence.excerpt: According to Ukrinform, the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine reported the operational situation as of 16:00 on Saturday, July 18, in a Facebook update. In the Kostiantynivka sector, Ukrainian forces repelled 10 Russian attacks near Kostiantynivka, Illinivka, and toward Kucheriv Yar. Two battles are ongoing. In the Pokrovsk sector, Russian forces attempted nine assaults near Dorozhne, Hryshyne, Udachne, Molodetske, and toward Kucheriv Yar.

evidence.publisher: UNN, citing the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine
evidence.excerpt: During the past day, July 15, 279 combat engagements were recorded. In the Kostiantynivka direction, the enemy carried out 30 attacks in the areas of the populated areas of Kostiantynivka, Illinivka, Ivanopillia, Sofiivka, as well as towards Vilne, Toretske, and Kucherovyi Yar.

evidence.publisher: Armed Forces of Ukraine / General Staff
evidence.excerpt: Загалом протягом минулої доби зафіксовано 244 бойові зіткнення. На Покровському напрямку наші захисники зупинили 37 штурмових дій агресора у районах населених пунктів Торецьке, Русин Яр, Василівка, Котлине, Удачне, Філія, Новоолександрівка та в бік населених пунктів Вільне, Білицьке, Новий Донбас, Шевченко, Мирне, Сергіївка, Новопавлівка.

evidence.publisher: Eurasia, republishing the ISW / Critical Threats July 14 assessment
evidence.excerpt: Russian forces conducted limited ground operations in the Dobropillya tactical area on July 13 to 14 but did not make confirmed advances.

evidence.publisher: Institute for the Study of War / AEI Critical Threats Project
evidence.excerpt: ISW has observed evidence to assess that Russian forces seized or infiltrated 30.42 square kilometers in June 2026 and advanced or infiltrated at an average pace of 1.01 square kilometers per day. Russian forces comparatively seized 481.25 square kilometers in June 2025, advancing at an average pace of 16.04 square kilometers per day.

question: Will the Sweden Democrats (SD) win the second most seats in the 2026 Swedish parliamentary election?
rules:
Parliamentary elections are scheduled to be held in Sweden on September 13, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the political party that wins the second-greatest number of seats in the Swedish Parliament (Riksdag) in this election.

If voting in the Swedish parliamentary election does not occur by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The named parties or coalitions will be primarily ranked by the number of seats won in the specified election. If two or more parties are tied on seats, ties will be broken by the total number of valid votes received, with higher vote totals ranking higher. If parties remain tied, ties will be broken by alphabetical order of the listed party abbreviations. This market will resolve to the party that occupies the second finishing position after applying this ranking.

This market will resolve based on the results of this election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Swedish government, specifically the Swedish Election Authority (Valmyndigheten) (https://www.val.se/).

evidence.publisher: Verian, polling for SVT
evidence.excerpt: The September 3 voter barometer put the Social Democrats at 29.2%, the Sweden Democrats at 18.9%, and the Moderates at 16.4%. The remaining parliamentary parties each polled between 3.0% and 8.1%. Verian conducted 3,069 interviews between August 20 and September 2, 2026; 12.5% of respondents did not name a party.

evidence.publisher: Demoskop, polling for Aftonbladet and Svenska Dagbladet
evidence.excerpt: Demoskop's September poll showed a sharp decline for the Social Democrats and an increase for the Sweden Democrats. Social Democratic support was 27.2%, while the Liberals increased to 2.8%. The survey comprised 1,998 online interviews conducted between August 25 and September 1; Demoskop does not report conventional margins of error because its monthly barometer is not based on a purely random population sample.

evidence.publisher: Novus
evidence.excerpt: Novus reported that Moderate support fell by 1.1 percentage points to 17.2%, while SD recovered its previous month's decline. Its hypothetical allocation of parliamentary seats was Social Democrats 95, Sweden Democrats 76, Moderates 63, Centre Party 31, Left Party 31, Greens 29, Christian Democrats 24, and Liberals zero. The survey covered 2,984 eligible voters interviewed between August 24 and August 30, 2026.

evidence.publisher: Valmyndigheten — Swedish Election Authority
evidence.excerpt: The official summary of the 2022 Riksdag election gives the Social Democrats 30.33% of votes and 107 seats, the Sweden Democrats 20.54% and 73 seats, and the Moderates 19.10% and 68 seats. The Riksdag's 349 seats were distributed among eight parties.

evidence.publisher: Demoskop, polling for Aftonbladet and Svenska Dagbladet
evidence.excerpt: Demoskop's additional August barometer reported that SD fell by almost two percentage points, narrowing the difference between SD and the Moderates to 1.1 percentage points. The opposition's aggregate lead was 5.7 percentage points. Christian Democratic support reached 8.5%, while the Liberals remained at 2.0%.

evidence.publisher: Verian, polling for SVT
evidence.excerpt: Verian's August barometer put the Social Democrats at 30.5%, the Sweden Democrats at 18.5%, and the Moderates at 17.3%. SD had polled below 19% for three consecutive measurements, while the Moderates had recorded support around 17% for five consecutive measurements. The survey comprised 3,043 interviews conducted between August 3 and August 16, 2026.

question: Will no qualifying diplomatic US-Iran meeting occur by September 30, 2026?
rules:

A qualifying round must be a deliberate in-person diplomatic meeting or negotiating round concerning US-Iran relations, involving senior representatives of both the United States and Iran who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to conduct or materially direct diplomacy on behalf of their governments.

Indirect in-person diplomacy through designated mediators, facilitators, or interlocutors will qualify, provided senior representatives of both the United States and Iran are participating in the same formal diplomatic process with the knowledge and authorization of their respective governments. evidence.publisher: Reuters, via The Times of Israel
evidence.excerpt: Qatar is working with partners in the region and around the world, including China, to resume talks between the United States and Iran, a Qatari foreign ministry spokesperson said. Qatar’s prime minister and foreign minister, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani, was leading a delegation in Beijing.

evidence.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Japan
evidence.excerpt: Japanese Foreign Minister Motegi Toshimitsu held a telephone call with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi on September 8. Motegi expressed concern about renewed exchanges of attacks between the United States and Iran, called for talks to resume as soon as possible, and requested Iranian flexibility to avoid prolonging the impasse. Both ministers agreed to maintain close communication toward a diplomatic resolution.

evidence.publisher: Institute for the Study of War and Critical Threats Project
evidence.excerpt: In its September 8 update, the Institute for the Study of War and Critical Threats Project reported nothing significant under its US-Iran negotiations section.

evidence.publisher: Daily News Egypt
evidence.excerpt: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei said contacts with regional countries to defuse the war were continuing and described meetings with a visiting Qatari delegation as good. He also said negotiations with Oman over a temporary safe transit route through the Strait of Hormuz were making significant progress. Baghaei blamed Washington for breaching the earlier memorandum of understanding and attributed insecurity in the strait to US attacks and the naval blockade.

evidence.publisher: Reuters, via MarketScreener
evidence.excerpt: Vice President JD Vance said the United States was not talking to Iran and would not do so unless Iran stopped shooting at commercial shipping. He presented an end to those attacks as the condition for resuming negotiations.

evidence.publisher: CNN, via KVIA
evidence.excerpt: CNN reported that US-Iran talks had stalled and that the White House had said the preceding Thursday that no negotiations were ongoing. Iran and Oman continued discussions on an arrangement to restore maritime traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, with regional mediators including Qatar backing those discussions. Iranian officials linked navigation through the strait to broader discussions with Washington and regional security developments.

evidence.publisher: Swiss Federal Department of Foreign Affairs
evidence.excerpt: Switzerland welcomed progress during diplomatic talks involving the mediators, Iran and the United States at the Bürgenstock overnight on June 21–22. It welcomed the establishment of a high-level committee and a roadmap targeting a final agreement within 60 days. The roadmap provided for the immediate resumption of technical discussions.

question: Will Messi and Ronaldo Shake Hands During World Cup?
rules:
This market will resolve “Yes” if Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo are observed physically shaking hands with one another at any point during the 2026 FIFA World Cup window. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

The 'handshake' must occur while the listed players are on the pitch or the bench area; handshakes in the locker room or other areas will not count. This can occur before, during, or after the match. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No."

If the 2026 FIFA World Cup is cancelled, postponed after August 2, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or no qualifying handshake can be confirmed within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “No”.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official match footage and broadcast video; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

evidence.publisher: Diario La Prensa
evidence.excerpt: Cristiano y Messi se saludaron también en el campo, pero un poco más serios. Los dos cracks se dieron una vez más las manos en el saludo con los árbitros, ambos son los capitanes de sus selecciones.
